justification: Same eleven that took the field last week, and I'm not blinking. Daniel Jones is our starter — Lawrence and Cousins project higher on somebody's spreadsheet, but we don't bench a kid who's earning it because a number says otherwise, and Jones is earning it. Dowdle's a Questionable tag, not a bench sentence — he told the room he's playing and put in a full week of work after a quiet 5.4, and a quiet week with full effort earns you the next start, not a seat. Same goes for Puka — he's Questionable, he says he's good, I trust the player's word over the injury report. Amon-Ra just went for 30.7 and Hampton's rolling, so momentum stays right where it is, and McLaurin, Andrews, McPherson and the Chargers defense all did their jobs and keep theirs. Clear eyes, full hearts — we're not changing who we are because Costanza's got jokes.
